ev-d0ff9b95cc.rationale: Legacy tier T0: the evidence is unresolved and the fixtures were unscored, so no outcome is asserted. Re-checked 2026-09-22 (#127, following #45): the Slack tokens page documents the xwfp- prefix for workflow tokens but states no section widths or alphabet for it, the same gap already recorded for xoxb-; the pinned trufflehog slack detector covers only xoxb-/xoxp-/xoxa-/xoxr-, and gitleaks's slack-webhook-url rule matches only the full hooks.slack.com/workflows/... URL, not a bare token. redact-secret#512 is closed (PR #532): the product completed xoxp-/xoxe-/xoxe.xoxb-/xoxe.xoxp- on tool-corroborated section grammar but explicitly left xapp- and xwfp- as an unpromoted interim guard, since xwfp- has no tool source at all and clears neither this project's two-source nor provider-plus-tool bar. This corpus's bar is unmet on that same evidence, not on an open product issue: pending until a pinned scanner registers a rule or Slack documents xwfp-'s section widths or alphabet.
